import pandas as pd

# Read the source CSV file with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_60/training_0.csv"
df_source = pd.read_csv(source_path, index_col=0)

# Group by 'type' and sum 'driver_count'
df_grouped = df_source.groupby('type', as_index=False)['driver_count'].sum()

# Ensure the schema matches target: 'type' as string, 'driver_count' as integer
df_grouped['type'] = df_grouped['type'].astype(str)
df_grouped['driver_count'] = df_grouped['driver_count'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path without the index column
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_60/target_multisource.csv"
df_grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
